name: 79-abbreviation-letters
description: An abbreviation matches case-insensitively as a scale word does: each letter matches itself or its capital. So 'U.ſ.' with a long s (U+017F) is no abbreviation, and its dot ends the sentence before a lowercase word. 'U.S.' still joins (spec 0.10, #350).
document: Fees are up to the U.ſ. code cap of $60. Fees are up to the U.S. code cap of $70.
